ui_same.ui.subtitle: Subtitle

ui_same.ui.tag_disabled_hint: Disabled tags leave site aggregates; linked videos keep the relation.
ui_same.ui.actors_lead: People library. Starring names on videos auto-create records; add avatars and bios here.

ui_same.ui.actor_off_hint: Offline hides the person page; starring names on videos stay.
ui_same.ui.empty_actors_hint: People pages use this library. Typing starring names on a video also creates them — come back to add avatars.
ui_same.ui.topics_lead: Curated lists such as New Year hits. Create a topic, then Bind videos; article sites can also Bind articles.
ui_same.ui.empty_topics_hint: Topics are curated lists, not categories. Create one, then bind videos for a front-page shelf.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_topics: Delete selected topics? Bound lists will be removed too.
ui_same.ui.hint_topic_level: Higher recommend values rank first on home/topic bars. Remarks are admin-only.
ui_same.ui.hint_topic_tpl: Theme template filename; usually leave blank.
ui_same.ui.hint_topic_status: Offline hides the topic page; bindings stay. Use Bind videos in the list.
ui_same.ui.bind_videos_empty: No videos yet. Search a title above and add.
ui_same.ui.bind_videos_hint: Search the catalog and add to this topic. Order is display order.
ui_same.ui.bind_arts_empty: No articles yet. Search a title above and add.
ui_same.ui.bind_arts_hint: Search articles and add to this topic. Order is display order.
ui_same.ui.links_lead: Footer links. Default theme prints text via @@vodLink. Hidden links leave the site. Top nav lives under Websites.
ui_same.ui.empty_links_hint: Footer links. Name and URL are enough; logo is optional.
ui_same.ui.hint_link_url: Missing scheme gets https://. Opens in a new tab.
ui_same.ui.hint_link_logo: Default theme ignores logo. Clear to show as text.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_links: Delete selected links? They will leave the footer.
ui_same.ui.slides_lead: Home carousel and play-page patches. Pick a slot, then upload a wide image and link.
ui_same.ui.empty_slides_hint: Slides power home carousels and play-page patches. Themes call them by slot.
ui_same.ui.hint_slide_name: Name shown in the admin list.
ui_same.ui.hint_slide_slot: Where it appears. Home for carousel; play page for player patches.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_slides: Delete selected slides? Themes will lose these images.
ui_same.ui.players_lead: Line “player” codes must match here. Use open-source engines for direct m3u8 / mp4 / flv; parsers only for encrypted URLs.
ui_same.ui.servers_lead: When a line picks a group, relative paths get this prefix. Absolute http(s) or // stay unchanged. Disabled or empty prefix leaves URLs as-is.
ui_same.ui.downloaders_lead: Download pages wrap episode URLs in a template. {url} is the address, {id} is the video id. This does not download files in admin.
ui_same.ui.engine_artplayer_lead: Default pick. MIT, actively maintained, direct HLS / FLV / MP4, easy to skin.
ui_same.ui.engine_dplayer_lead: Common in Apple CMS. Built-in danmaku; good for existing DPlayer lines.
ui_same.ui.engine_videojs_lead: Best compatibility with built-in HLS. Larger bundle; solid for direct links.
ui_same.ui.engine_parse_lead: Opens a parse page in iframe. Use {url} and {id} in the address.
ui_same.ui.hint_player_name: Name shown in the admin list.
ui_same.ui.hint_player_code: Must match the player field on video lines. Collectors often use dplayer or parse.
ui_same.ui.hint_player_parse: Only for the parser engine. Use {url} and {id}. Leave blank for direct engines.
ui_same.ui.empty_players_hint: Seed ArtPlayer, DPlayer, Video.js, and a parser first.

ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_players: Delete selected players? Ones still used by lines will be kept.
ui_same.ui.hint_server_try: Uses saved and enabled groups. Absolute URLs are not prefixed; disabled or empty prefix leaves the path as-is.
ui_same.ui.hint_server_name: Shown in the line “server group” dropdown. Keep names unique.
ui_same.ui.hint_server_url: Optional. Empty keeps relative paths as-is. No javascript:. Paths starting with / are path prefixes (https is not added).
ui_same.ui.hint_server_status: Disabled groups stay in the dropdown but do not prefix; already-built URLs are not rewritten.
ui_same.ui.empty_servers_hint: Add one with a name. Prefix is optional. Download templates are under Downloaders; playback engines under Players.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_servers: Delete selected server groups? Ones used by lines cannot be deleted.
ui_same.ui.please_fill_try_path: Enter a relative path to try

ui_same.ui.hint_downer_code: Must match the downloader field on lines. Collectors often use http or xunlei.
ui_same.ui.hint_downer_parse: {url} / {id} are replaced; a bare prefix is prepended; empty leaves the URL as-is. Does not fetch files.
ui_same.ui.empty_downloaders_hint: Add one with a code and template. Direct links can leave the template blank. Playback engines are under Players.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_downloaders: Delete selected downloaders? Ones used by lines cannot be deleted.
ui_same.ui.please_fill_try_url: Enter a download URL to try

ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_domains: Delete selected bindings? The catalog stays; this host no longer overrides name/theme.

ui_same.ui.ph_member_password: Required for new; leave blank to keep
ui_same.ui.hint_member_name: Shown in comments and the member center.
ui_same.ui.hint_member_email: Front-end account only — cannot access admin.

ui_same.ui.hint_member_points: Used for VOD charges. Changes are logged.

ui_same.ui.empty_groups_hint: Create tiers like Member / VIP, then assign people.

ui_same.ui.confirm_del_group_people: “:name” still has :n members. They become ungrouped. Continue?
ui_same.ui.ph_card: Search code, user, or member ID

ui_same.ui.hint_card_points: Credited on redeem. Redeemed cards cannot be edited.

ui_same.ui.hint_bind_after_save: After saving, bind categories — unbound types are skipped.
ui_same.ui.confirm_collect_all: This pulls the full library page by page and may be slow. Continue?

ui_same.ui.bind_hint_manga: Map remote categories to manga types. Unbound types are skipped. Chapters need image URLs, not reader pages.

ui_same.ui.comments_lead_art: Article comments (not video). With moderation on, new comments start as pending.
ui_same.ui.comments_migrate: Run database migrations first so article comments stay separate from video comments.
ui_same.ui.empty_comments_hint_vod: Player-page comments appear here. Turn on moderation (top right) to require review first.
ui_same.ui.empty_comments_hint_art: Article-page comments appear here. Turn on moderation (top right) to require review first.
ui_same.ui.comment_status_hint: “Visible” shows on the detail page; “Pending / hidden” stays off the front. With moderation on, new comments start as pending.
ui_same.ui.collects_lead_after: . Bind categories first, then collect today — unbound types are skipped. Manga chapter URLs must be image URLs. Unsure? Try
ui_same.ui.ph_plog: Search remark, member name, or ID
ui_same.ui.plogs_lead: Points statement. Play charges, top-ups, card redemptions, and admin adjustments are logged. Deleting a row does not change member balances.

ui_same.ui.empty_plogs_hint: Play charges, top-ups, card redemptions, and admin adjustments appear here.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_plogs: Delete selected records? Member points stay the same; only these statement rows are removed.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_plog: Delete this ledger row? Member points stay the same.

ui_same.ui.plot_video_missing: Video #:id does not exist; save will fail.
ui_same.ui.hint_plot_video: Must link to an existing video.
ui_same.ui.hint_episode: One plot per episode per video. Play URLs need not be ready yet.
ui_same.ui.ph_plot_title: Optional; empty shows episode number in the list
ui_same.ui.ph_plot_content: What happens in this episode — not the full script
ui_same.ui.hint_sort_asc: Lower numbers appear first. Usually leave as is.
ui_same.ui.empty_plots_hint: Add one with a video, episode number, and synopsis. Not generated from play URLs.
ui_same.ui.please_fill_episode: Please enter an episode number starting from 1
ui_same.ui.please_fill_plot: Please enter the plot for this episode

ui_same.ui.no_match_videos_hint: Try another keyword, or clear queue filters.

ui_same.ui.empty_ads_hint: Ads are HTML for the header, footer, or play page. Themes call them by slot after you create them.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_ads: Delete selected ads? Themes will no longer get this code.

ui_same.ui.generated_invite_hint: — copy and send to people who will register

ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_void_invites: Void selected invite codes? Used ones stay.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_invites: Delete selected invite codes? Used ones stay.
ui_same.ui.confirm_void_invite: Void “:code”? It cannot be used to register afterward.

ui_same.ui.hint_withdraw_remark: Remark only — does not change status or deduct points.

ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_withdraws: Delete selected withdrawals? Record only — no point refund.
ui_same.ui.confirm_pay_withdraw: Mark “:name” paid? Deducts :yuan yuan (:fen fen) once.
ui_same.ui.confirm_reject_withdraw: Reject this withdrawal? No points deducted.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_withdraw: Delete this withdrawal? Record only — no point refund.
ui_same.ui.ph_report: Search content, title, or video ID
ui_same.ui.reports_lead: Cannot-play / dead-URL reports from the detail page. Mark them done when handled; delete removes the record only and does not change play URLs. Player-logged failures are under Play failures.
ui_same.ui.empty_reports_hint: Visitor “cannot play / dead URL” reports from the video page appear here. Marking done does not change lines automatically.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_reports: Delete selected reports? Record only — play URLs unchanged.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_report: Delete this report? Record only — play URLs unchanged.
ui_same.ui.synonyms_lead: When a visitor searches the original word, look up the mapped word instead. Collect ingest renames titles too. Names already in the library are not changed. Hot searches live under Search terms.
ui_same.ui.ph_try_synonym: Enter a word to see if enabled rules remap it
ui_same.ui.try_synonym_hint: Uses saved, enabled rules only, replacing from longest original word first. Disabled and unsaved drafts are ignored.
ui_same.ui.ph_to_word: Word used to look up videos
ui_same.ui.synonym_form_hint: Both sides must differ. One rule per original word. Mapped word cannot be empty or searches will return nothing.
ui_same.ui.meta_empty_to: Mapped word is empty; enabling would empty searches
ui_same.ui.empty_synonyms_hint: Add a rule to map common misspellings or aliases to library titles. Existing titles are not renamed.
ui_same.ui.from_to_same: Original and mapped words must differ
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_synonyms: Delete selected rules? Video titles stay unchanged.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_synonym: Delete rule “:name”? Video titles stay unchanged.
ui_same.ui.searchwords_lead: Front-end searches are counted automatically. Hot means 10+ hits. Deleting does not change videos. You can also add one manually and raise hits to rank it higher.
ui_same.ui.hint_searchword_hits: Each visitor search adds 1. Raise the number to push a hot term.
ui_same.ui.empty_searchwords_hint: A front-end search will show up here. Or add a hot term first.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_searchwords: Delete selected search terms? Videos stay unchanged.
ui_same.ui.ph_recycle: Search deleted video title or ID
ui_same.ui.recycle_lead: Deleted videos land here first. Restore returns them to the list; purge cannot be undone. Nothing is auto-cleared.
ui_same.ui.empty_recycle_hint: Videos deleted from the list appear here and can be restored anytime. Nothing is auto-cleared.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_restore: Restore :n selected to the video list?
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_purge: Permanently delete :n selected? This cannot be undone.
ui_same.ui.confirm_empty_recycle: Permanently delete every video in the recycle bin? This cannot be undone.
ui_same.ui.confirm_purge_vod: Permanently delete “:name”? This cannot be undone.
ui_same.ui.ph_playfail: Search title, line, URL, or video ID
ui_same.ui.playfails_lead_before: Logged when visitors tap “Report play error” on the play page. Marking done
ui_same.ui.playfails_lead_after: . Use Offline line to disable that source. Text reports from detail pages are under Reports.
ui_same.ui.empty_playfails_hint: When visitors report a play error, it appears here. Offline a bad line; delete only removes the record.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_offline: Offline play lines linked to selected records? Front end will hide those lines.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_playfails: Delete selected records? Only the logs are removed; play lines stay.
ui_same.ui.confirm_offline_line: Offline the play line linked to this failure? Front end will hide that line.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_playfail: Delete this play failure? Only the log is removed; the play line stays.
ui_same.ui.arts_lead: Site news, not films. Sections are for articles only, separate from video categories. Deletes go to trash and can be restored.
ui_same.ui.empty_arts_hint: Create an article section first, then come back to write.
ui_same.ui.please_pick_column: Pick a section, then click Move
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_arts: Deletes go to trash and can be restored. Delete selected articles?
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_art: Delete “:name”? It goes to trash and can be restored.
ui_same.ui.art_tag_compose_lead: Press Enter to add more. To edit the URL,
ui_same.ui.art_tag_compose_tail: . Article tags only — not the video tag library.
ui_same.ui.art_tags_lead: Aggregation labels for articles (news, lists) — not sections or video tags. Video tags are under Videos → More. Manga tags under Manga → Tags. Deleting a tag only removes the label; articles stay.
ui_same.ui.empty_art_tags_hint: Type a name above to add tags for grouping articles.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_art_tags: Delete selected tags? Articles stay; only the labels are removed.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_art_tag_used: “:name” is on :n articles. Deleting only removes the tag; articles stay. Continue?
ui_same.ui.empty_types_hint: Categories are the video library tree. Create a top level, then add children like Action or Domestic.
ui_same.ui.empty_art_types_hint: Sections are the article directory. Create a top level, then Add child for nested channels.
ui_same.ui.empty_nav_types_hint: Create top-level groups like Tools or Resources, then children. Then assign sites under Websites.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_types: Delete selected :name? Rows with children or :content are skipped.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_type: Delete “:name”? Cannot delete if it has children or :content.
ui_same.ui.ext_classes_hint: When this list is empty, category pages use genre words already on videos. Once enabled words exist here, filters show only these. Collect writes words on videos — it does not fill this table.
ui_same.ui.hint_ext_class_name: One word at a time. Shown as Genre on category pages. Do not use Movie or Series — those are categories.
ui_same.ui.empty_ext_classes_hint: Add words like Comedy or Action. The category tree is under Categories — do not create Movie or Series here.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_ext_classes: Delete selected genre words? Words on videos stay; only this dictionary shrinks.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_ext_class: Delete genre word “:name”? Words on videos stay.
ui_same.ui.notifies_lead: Member ID 0 (or empty) goes to everyone; a specific ID reaches only that member. Use Messages for one-to-one. You can mark read here; deleting removes the record.
ui_same.ui.hint_notify_compose: Defaults to all members. Enter an ID for one person; one-to-one fits Messages better.
ui_same.ui.empty_notifies_hint: Use “Send notice” (top right). Defaults to all members; use Messages for one person.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_notifies: Delete selected notices? Members will no longer see them.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_notify: Delete this notice? The member will no longer see it.
ui_same.ui.pms_lead: Sent to a specific member; they see it in Messages after login. Opening the inbox marks all read. Use Member notices for everyone.
ui_same.ui.hint_pm_compose: Send to one person. Find the ID under Members.
ui_same.ui.empty_pms_hint: Use “Message member” (top right) for one person. Site-wide announcements live under Member notices.
ui_same.ui.please_fill_to_member_id: Please enter the recipient member ID
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_pms: Delete selected messages? Members will no longer see them.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_pm: Delete this message? The member will no longer see it.
ui_same.ui.favorites_lead: Appear when members favorite a video page. Admin cannot add favorites. Deleting only clears that member’s list, not the video.
ui_same.ui.empty_favorites_hint: After members favorite a video while logged in, records appear here. Admin cannot add favorites.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_unfavor: Remove these :n favorites? Videos are not deleted.
ui_same.ui.confirm_unfavor: Remove the favorite for “:name”? The video is not deleted.
ui_same.ui.guestbooks_lead_audit: New posts start pending and show on the front guestbook after approval. Replies appear under the visitor’s post. Video comments are under Comments.
ui_same.ui.guestbooks_lead_open: New posts show on the front immediately. To require review first, turn on guestbook moderation under Moderation settings. Replies appear under the visitor’s post.
ui_same.ui.hint_gbook_readonly: Visitor text cannot be edited. Your reply appears under this post.
ui_same.ui.hint_gbook_status: “Visible” shows on the front guestbook; hidden hides the whole post including the reply.
ui_same.ui.empty_guestbooks_hint: Visitor posts from the front guestbook appear here. To require review first, open Moderation settings (top right).
ui_same.ui.collect_tasks_lead_before: Due jobs pull from your sources automatically. No sources yet? Add one under
ui_same.ui.collect_tasks_lead_after: first. Backup, push, and plugin jobs live under Backup / push / plugins. The server must run php artisan schedule:run every minute. Use Run due jobs to check immediately. Deleting a task does not change the catalog.
ui_same.ui.empty_collect_tasks_hint: Add a collect source, then schedule today’s updates.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_tasks: Delete selected tasks? The catalog stays unchanged.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_collect_task: Delete this scheduled job? The catalog stays unchanged.
ui_same.ui.collect_logs_lead: Each Today / This week / All run on a source adds a row. Read the note on failures. Deleting logs does not change the catalog.
ui_same.ui.empty_collect_logs_hint: Run Today on a source and it appears here.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_logs: Delete selected rows? The catalog stays; only these log lines go away.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_collect_log: Delete this log row? The catalog stays unchanged.
ui_same.ui.collect_temps_lead_on: New items land here first. Check cover and category, then promote to the catalog. Deleting a row does not remove items already imported.
ui_same.ui.collect_temps_lead_off_before: Collect writes straight to the catalog, so this list is usually empty. To review first, open
ui_same.ui.collect_temps_lead_off_after: and switch to pending review before import.
ui_same.ui.empty_collect_temps_hint: Run Today on a source and items appear here.
ui_same.ui.empty_collect_temps_direct: Collect goes straight to the catalog; nothing pending here.
ui_same.ui.empty_collect_temps_direct_hint: To review before import, enable the temp table in settings.
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_promote: Promote selected items to the catalog?
ui_same.ui.confirm_batch_del_temps: Delete selected rows? Items already imported stay in the catalog.
ui_same.ui.confirm_del_collect_temp: Delete this pending row? Imported items stay in the catalog.
ui_same.ui.collect_task_form_lead: Pick a source and how often to run. When due, it pulls today / last 7 days / full library; runs appear under Collect logs. Backup, push, and plugin jobs (e.g. stats) are under Backup / push / plugins.
ui_same.ui.hint_unbound_skip: Unbound categories on this source are skipped when the job runs.
ui_same.ui.hint_hours_range: Today is usually enough. Full library pulls page by page and can be slow.
ui_same.ui.hint_pages: Pages per run. 1–3 is often enough for today’s updates.
ui_same.ui.hint_task_status: Turn off to keep the job but skip scheduling. You can still Run now from the list.
